items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: So now my first job I played with, with Kidore and his band was a place they called the Palm Garden.

ctx.x: And you were going to tell about when you joined Kidore.

Yeah, I played in his drummer's place, in Henry Martin's place. Henry Martin was playing out at a place on the, at West End, they call it the Bungalow. I guess you heard of that nightclub, the Bungalow. Well, on Sunday nights, Saturdays and Sundays, that was his busy night out there. He couldn't get off, you see. So after we heard me play with Tick Chambers, well, he said, well, let's try. When it's Kelly, he boosts me up, you know, so I was going to make a good drummer and give him a try. I said, he's a good…
